title: Two degenerate intersections of Clifford tori in \(S^2\times S^2\) and \(\CP^2\)
summary: We construct smooth time-periodic Hamiltonians on the monotone manifolds \(S^2\times S^2\) and \(\CP^2\) for which the Clifford torus meets its Hamiltonian image in exactly two isolated degenerate points.
